investor_message_milestone_1: Hi, Tomar sathe alap hoye bhalo laglo, amar naam Rosy, ami Devhives theke tomar notun advisor. Tomar website er niche milestone gulo kheyal korecho? Proti bar ekta milestone complete korlei sathe sathe ekta payment pabe. Shuru koro ekta office niye. Amra bolbo map er top left corner er Small Building ta rent koro.
investor_message_milestone_4: Wow! Tomar notun Landing Page dekhe lok {productName} niye nishchoi excited hobe! Ekhon traffic anar jonno ektu marketing lagbe shudhu. Tomar website e giye Marketing Tab select koro. Okhan theke ekta Email Campaign create koro ar dekho registered users kivabe barche. Daily budget barate bhoy peo na.
investor_message_milestone_satisfaction: Darun kaj, tomar prothom asol feature! Features tab er top left corner e smiley ta kheyal korecho? Eta dekhay tomar users koto satisfied. Ekhon ora khub ekta khushi na, karon tomar notun feature er level khub kom. Satisfaction high rakha khub important. Eta kome gele users tomar website chhede chole jete shuru korbe. Tomar notun feature er level bariye website er satisfaction barao. Dorkari module banate tomake ekta Lead Developer hire korte hobe.
investor_message_milestone_more_users: Beautiful! Feature upgrade korar somoy (potential users barate) shob feature er level balance kore rakhar chesta korbe, tahole users khushi thakbe. Amader aro users lagbe! Email Campaigns chalie jao. Kheyal rakho jeno potential users tomar registered users er cheye beshi thake. Feature level upgrade kore potential users barao.
investor_message_milestone_8: Eto users! Mante hobe, {investorName} er lok ra ekhon tomar success er upor bet lagate shuru koreche, amra khub impressed! Ekhon server niye kotha bolte hobe. Jotoi feature add ba upgrade korbe, toto beshi CU (Compute Units) lagbe. Developer ar Designer er motoi ekta SysAdmin hire kore shuru koro. Tarpor tomar website select kore Hosting Tab e click kore ekta Mini Cloud Server add koro. Dorkari component gulo banate tomar SysAdmin ke use koro.
investor_message_milestone_first_income: Ei to hoye gelo. Server load er dike nojor rakhte bhulo na. 100% er upore gele users haraate shuru korbe. Ekhon aste aste kichu income generate korar dike focus korte hobe. Shuru koro ekta khali feature slot e Text Ads feature research kore add kore. Tarpor ekta Sales Executive hire koro ar tomar prothom ad contract negotiate koro.
investor_message_milestone_more_workstat: Good job! Income steady rakhte bhulo na, ar je deal gulo te negotiation lagbe segulor response dio. Kheyal korecho amader staff ra ekjon arekjoner kache ghneshe boshte shuru koreche? Developer ra eta ekdom pochondo kore na! Ekta boro office neya-i bhalo. City Map e jao ar ekta boro office rent koro.
investor_message_milestone_valuation: Bhalo choice! Next milestone er jonno amra chai tumi shudhu tomar website er upor kaj koro. Feature level upgrade korte thako ar marketing campaign chalao. Notun employee hire korte bhoy peo na. Tomar website er Stats tab e tomar current valuation dekhte parbe. Ebar giye target valuation e pouchao.
investor_message_milestone_more_users_2: Arekta darun bhabe complete kora milestone! Accha, ebar amader marketing aro bhalo korar dike nojor dite hobe. Shuru koro ekta marketer hire kore. Tarpor tomar prothom Text Ads campaign create koro. Insight feature ta ekbar dekhe nio. Kono campaign tar audience er 10% e pouchale tumi aro insight pabe. Dekhe neoa worth it! Target registered users e pouchao.
investor_message_milestone_12: {productName} er eto darun growth er jonno congratulations. Ebar framework niye kotha bolte hobe. Ekhon tumi ekta free framework use korcho, jeta future e amader je feature level lagbe seta handle korte parbe na. Framework upgrade korte tomar website er Features Tab er top right corner e Upgrade button e click koro.
investor_message_milestone_13: Darun choice! Notun framework diye tumi onek beshi feature level e pouchate parbe. Abar server niye kotha bolar time. Ekhon obdhi amra "cloud servers" use korechi, mane basically onno karo server ja amra rent nii. Amader mone hoy {productName} er jonno nijeder server nijeder kache ana (insourcing) bhalo idea. Shuru koro City Map e giye server hosting er jonno ekta suitable building rent kore.
investor_message_milestone_14: Tomar ekdom notun hosting facility te welcome! Ekhane tumi dami cloud server rent na kore nijer server kinte ar setup korte parbe. Shuru koro ekta rack kine boshie. Ekhanei amra amader server gulo install korbo. Tomar notun rack e click koro ar install koro 1 ta web server, 1 ta database server ar 1 ta cache server. Shesh e, kheyal rakho jeno shob server configure kora thake, server e click kore tarpor Configure button e click korlei hobe. Target Produced CU e pouchao.
investor_message_milestone_15: Darun! Amader SysAdmin ra bolche notun server gulo ekdom optimally cholche. Tomar next milestone ta ekta boro milestone. Ekhon amra proti mashe taka haracchi. Amra chai tumi khela ghuriye dao ar profit koro. Notun feature ana ar improve kora, marketing campaign chalano ar tomar notun hosting center expand kora chalie jao. Aro Sales Executive hire kora hoyto bhalo idea, jate tomar ad schedule e kono gap na thake. Ami tomar sathe abar jogajog korbo jokhon company bhalo poriman taka income korbe.
investor_message_milestone_more_users_3: Oh my gosh, congratulations! {productName} officially profit korche! Ami ekhon-i baki investor der sathe kotha bollam, amra shobai mone kori ebar level up korar time! Marketing campaign chalao, feature upgrade koro ar aro server install koro. Tomar life easy korte Manager hire korte bhulo na. Target registered users e pouchao.
investor_message_milestone_higher_cpm: Tumi khub tara-tari progress korcho, well done! Ami ekhon-i conference room theke berolam, board mone kore tumi aro onek beshi taka kamate paro! Jodi age na kore thako, Banner Ads ba Video Ads er moto beshi paying revenue feature implement koro. Satisfaction er dike nojor rakhte bhulo na, amra chai na eta 50% er niche nami! Kichu notun deal negotiate koro ar target website income e pouchao.
investor_message_milestone_16: Investor ra super excited! Shesh bar jokhon ader khobor pelam, ora celebrate korte nijeder private jet e Marbella ure jacchilo. Tumi ekhon officially success! Celebrate kora hoye gele ekta notun goal e focus korte shuru koro: ekta competitor acquire kora. Er jonno shudhu onek taka-i lagbe na, merge theke je notun users ashbe tader handle korte amader data center o scale korte hobe. Jotokkhon na ekta competitor acquire korar moto taka hocche, totokkhon capital build korte thako.

Contract Length Expire howar age contract koto din cholbe. Somoy er age contract cancel korle cancellation fee dite hobe. Lomba contract mane beshi price/CPM.
Offer Negotiation er age current CPM (protiti 1000 impressions er price), guaranteed impressions ar contract length er upor based.
Penalty Fee Guaranteed impressions deliver korte na parle CPM er koto percentage tomake pay korte hobe.
Daily Payment Contract active thakakalin protidin tumi je payment pabe.
help_ad_contracts_timeslots_description: Din take onek gulo time slots e bhag kore tumi ekoi Ads Feature e multiple contracts chalate paro.
help_controlling_time_intro: Game window er ekdom upore arrow buttons e click kore tumi time er speed control korte paro.
help_controlling_time_toggle: Pause button toggle kora jay, tai shohoje last select kora play speed e fire jete paro.
help_citymap_intro: Citymap e Startup Company er shob buildings er access pabe. Building duto type er: Office ar Hosting.
help_citymap_description: Shob buildings rent e neya, protidin pay korte hoy. Notun building e move korle ekta upfront payment dite hoy.
help_citymap_building_types_office_descr:
Office buildings e tomar shob employees thake. Shob kaj ekhanei hoy.

Ekta office building e koto gulo workstations (employees) rakha jabe tar limit ache. Kichu buildings e onek gulo floor ache.
help_citymap_building_types_hosting_desc:
Hosting buildings e tomar shob racks ar servers thake. Dedicated hosting buildings tokhoni kaje lagbe jokhon tumi virtual servers er maximum number e pouche gecho.

Hosting building e koto gulo device install korbe tar kono limit nei, shudhu physical jaygar limit chhara. Protiti building ekta initial temperature niye ashe. Temperature joto kom, tomar servers er toto kom cooling lagbe.
help_purchase_intro: Jokhon tumi kono building e thako, Purchase Menu diye items kinte paro.
help_purchase_description: Shob items kinar age Research Menu theke research korte hobe. Kon items pabe seta tumi kon type er building (office ba hosting) select korecho tar upor depend kore.
help_purchase_adding_items_description:
1. Purchase Menu theke ekta item select koro.

2. ba R press kore item ta rotate koro.

3. press kore location confirm koro.
help_purchase_moving_items_description:
1. Mouse diye item er upor hover koro ar press koro.

2. Mouse ta notun location e niye jao ar press kore confirm koro.
help_purchase_removing_items_description:
1. Mouse diye item er upor hover koro ar press koro.

2. DELETE press kore ba niche bam corner e Archive Icon e click kore item ta archive koro.

Items remove korle segulo delete hoy na. Shudhu tomar item inventory te chole jay, pore abar free te item ta place korte parbe.
help_purchase_tip: Tip: Item place korar shomoy <key>SHIFT</key> chepe dhore rakhle ekoi item onek bar place korte parbe.
help_researching_intro: Startup Company te shob kichu Research Menu diye unlock korte hoy. Kono item unlock korle seta shathe shathe relevant jaygay available hoye jabe.
help_researching_description: Shob unlockables unlock korte ekta nirdishto porimaan Research Points khoroch korte hoy. Researchers hire kore tumi Research Points produce korte paro.
help_researching_tip: Tip: Shob kichu unlock hoye gele Researchers der ar dorkar nei, tumi nishchinte oder fire korte paro.
help_recruitment_intro: Tumi tomar Chief Executive Officer ba ekta Recruiter diye employees recruit ar hire korte paro.
help_recruitment_headhunting_description:
Employees recruit kora hoy duto step e. Prothome, tumi potential candidates headhunt koro. Recruiters shudhu nijer level er employees headhunt korte pare.

Tumi protiti candidate er expected salary research korte paro. Ete employee koto salary expect kore tar bhalo ekta estimate pabe. Ditiyo, tumi chaile employee er demands o research korte paro. Ete tumi emon candidates der avoid korte parbe jara tomar current office ar enabled benefits er sathe fit kore na.

Egulor je kono detail research korle ekta candidate headhunt korte beshi time lagbe.

Headhunt kora candidates shudhu 96 ghonta available thakbe.
help_recruitment_negotiation_description: Candidates er sathe negotiate korar shomoy tumi chaile oder ekta signing bonus offer korte paro. Ekbarer upfront bonus diye kom monthly salary te deal pakka korar eta ekta effective upay.
help_recruitment_instant_hire_descriptio:
Expert Recruiters ekta fixed salary te candidate ke shathe shathe hire korte pare. Ete onek time-consuming negotiation process ta skip kora jay.

"Instantly Hire" enable korte, tomar Recruiter ke Expert level hote hobe ar salary ar demands duto i research kora thakte hobe.
help_features_intro:
Startup Company te website features duto type er: Base Features & Revenue Features. Ekta feature tomar website e ekta slot nibe. Tomar current framework joto slots support kore, tomar totoi slots thakbe.

Shob features Research Menu diye research korte hobe.
help_features_base_features_description:
Base Features tomar website er User Capacity baray. Koto capacity barbe seta feature er level er upor depend kore. Upgrade button press kore level upgrade korte paro. Protiti level e kichu components ba modules lage.

Protibar feature upgrade korle seta aro beshi Compute Units khabe ar tomar website er response time barbe. Eta samlate tumi feature er efficiency improve korte paro. Efficiency 100% obdhi jete pare ar eta response time ar consumed compute units duto i komay.
help_features_revenue_features_descripti:
Revenue Features, Base Features er moto na, kono compute units (CU) nay na ar website er response time o baray na. Bodole egulo diye tumi tomar website theke income korte paro.

Income source duto type er: Ads & Subscriptions. Duto i website satisfaction komay. Number joto kom, end-users feature ta niye toto unhappy.

Framework Limitations

Tomar current framework thik kore dey tomar features koto high level e jete pare ar koto gulo feature add korte paro. Jokhon shob feature slots bhora ar shob feature maximum level e pouche jabe, tokhon framework upgrade korte parbe.
help_frameworks_intro:
Framework holo tomar website er structure. Shob features tomar framework er upore banano hoy.

Shob website shuru hoy ekta Basic Framework diye. Tarpor Research Menu diye research korar pore tumi onek rokom frameworks e upgrade korte parbe.

Notun frameworks tomar overall compute unit (CU) consumption komabe, feature slots barabe ar maximum feature level barabe.
help_frameworks_upgrade_description:
Notun framework e upgrade korte duto jinish lage:

  • Shob feature slots bhora thakte hobe.
  • Shob base features maximum level e upgrade kora thakte hobe.

Ei requirements puron hole tumi framework upgrade korte parbe. Shob frameworks e ekta upfront payment lage.
help_satisfaction_intro:
Tomar website er satisfaction growth ar success er jonno khub important.

Website er satisfaction rating tinte jinish diye thik hoy:

  • Base features er satisfaction
  • Koto gulo revenue features use hocche
  • Support satisfaction
help_satisfaction_more_details: Smiley er upor hover korle satisfaction niye aro details pabe.
help_satisfaction_effect_description:
Tomar website er satisfaction 50% er niche gele tumi registered users harate shuru korbe.

Marketing campaigns ar organic growth koto effective hobe seta tomar satisfaction rating er upor depend kore. Satisfaction joto beshi, notun users pawa toto shohoj.
help_hosting_intro: Website online rakhte hole hosting er kheyal rakhte hobe. Duto jinish e nojor rakho: Server Load ar Response Time.
help_hosting_server_load_description: Server load kokhono 100% er upore jawa uchit na. Gele, tomar website er response time barte shuru korbe. Taratari server load komate aro servers install kore compute units (CU) barao.
help_hosting_response_time_description: Response time khub beshi hoye gele ar tomar website Unstable ba Critical e chole gele, bujhbe je tomake tomar website features er efficiency improve korte hobe.
help_hosting_servers_description:
Shob notun website shuru hoy Virtual Servers diye. Egulo diye tumi daily basis e servers rent korte paro.

Servers compute units (CU) produce kore. Website smoothly chalate hole, tomar website er joto CU lage tar cheye beshi produce korte hobe.

Website boro hote thakle Virtual Servers diye ar chalano jabe na, tokhon tomake ekta Hosting Building rent kore nijer servers setup korte shuru korte hobe.
help_hosting_types_virtual_servers_descr:
Kono initial investment lage na. Fast ar easy. Limited number of servers available.

Protiti CU er price beshi.
help_hosting_types_hosting_building_desc:
Upfront cost onek beshi, karon hosting building rent korte hoy plus racks ar servers kine setup korte hoy.

Protiti CU er price kom.
help_hosting_types_tip: Tip: Website er dorkar mitate Virtual Servers ar Hosting Buildings pashapashi chalano jay.
help_hosting_configuration_description:
Shob servers e kichu components lage. Components produce korte tomar ekta SysAdmin lagbe.

Servers configure korte components khoroch hoye gele segulo ar ferot pawa jay na.
help_marketing_intro:
Tomar website e notun traffic ante marketing campaign use korte paro.

Marketing campaign 6 type er. Oder moddhe parthokko shudhu cost ar conversion rate e.

Email campaigns chhara shob campaigns e marketing components lage. Components produce korte tomar ekta Marketer lagbe.
help_marketing_conversionrate_descriptio:
Marketing campaign chalanor shomoy tumi limited kichu lok ke tomar website er ads dekhabe. Conversion rate bole dey eder moddhe koto jon asole tomar ad e click kore tomar website er visitor hoy.

High conversion rate mane beshi lok tomar ad e click kore, ar jara care kore na tader ads dekhiye taka noshto hoy na.
help_marketing_reach_description: Reach bole dey koto lok potentially tomar ad dekhte pare. Higher level features jegulo onekdin promote kora hoy ni, tader reach sobcheye beshi hobe.
help_marketing_cpm_description: CPM bole dey 1000 lok ke tomar ad dekhate koto pay korcho. Beshi CPM pay kora prayi worth it, jodi conversion rate o toto tai beshi hoy.
help_marketing_targeting_description:
Targeting use kore tumi conversion rate improve korte paro. Targeting limit kora mane tomar ads shudhu ekta specific audience/type er lok ke dekhano.

Kono target match korche kina jante hole tomake campaign ta research korte hobe.
help_marketing_targeting_example: Uporer example e dekhbe je Food, Sports ar Age 26-50 bhalo match chilo. Ulto dike, Entertainment ar Males target kora conversion rate er jonno kharap chilo.
help_racks_intro: Nijer Hosting Building setup kora shuru hoy Research Menu e pochonder racks ar servers research kore.
help_racks_setting_up_description: Racks holo boro containers er moto ja e onek gulo server rakha jay. Racks Purchase Menu theke kinte hoy ar office buildings e furniture er motoi place korte hoy.
help_racks_installing_description:
Servers racks e install kora hoy. Ekta server nirdishto kichu "units" jayga nay. Shob racks e maximum koto units ba "Us" available ache.

Virtual servers er motoi, ekta server kaj korar age components diye configure korte hobe. Server configure hoye gele throughput produce korte shuru korbe.
help_racks_throughput_description:
Throughput tin type er: Web, Cache ar Database. CU produce korte tinte i lagbe. Prayi shob shomoy ekta throughput baki gulor cheye kom thakbe.
    Eta ke amra boli "the bottleneck". Sobcheye kom throughput tai thik kore tomar hosting building koto CU produce korbe.
help_racks_throughput_example: Uporer example e database holo bottleneck, tai produced CU barate aro Database Servers install kora uchit.
help_temperatures_understanding_descript:
Rack e jokhon aro servers add korbe, temperature dhire dhire barbe. Ekshomoy servers khub beshi gorom hoye jabe ar performance e effect porbe.

Servers puro building er temperature e contribute kore. Building temperature shob rack temperatures ke directly affect kore.
help_temperatures_servermodes_descriptio: Server er bam dike circle er color dekhe server mode chena jay. Racks er overlays o erokom color coded:
help_temperatures_servermodes_reduced_pe: Ek ba ekadhik servers Reduced Performance Mode e ache.
help_temperatures_servermodes_overheat: Ek ba ekadhik servers Overheat Protection e ache.
help_temperatures_servermodes_not_config: Ek ba ekadhik servers configure kora nei.
help_temperatures_reduced_performance_de: Server throughput produce korche kintu performance kome geche.
help_temperatures_overheat_protection_de: High temperature er jonno kono damage avoid korte server shut down hoye geche. Kono throughput produce hocche na.
help_temperatures_overclocking_descripti:
Shob servers overclock kora jay. Server overclock kora mane clock rate barano. Ete server beshi throughput produce korbe, kintu beshi power o khabe ar beshi heat toiri korbe.

Server overclock korle overall temperature bere jay, tai oi server ar onno servers - duto r i overheating issues hote pare.
help_temperatures_overclocking_extended: Overclocking diye heat ar temperature komano o jay. Clock rate 100% er niche korle server kom throughput produce korbe, kintu kom power khabe ar kom heat toiri korbe.
help_temperatures_overclocking_tip: Tip: Ekta Centralized Clock Rate Controller (CCC) install kore ekshathe onek servers er clock rate control koro.
help_vc_ownership_description:
Ownership bole dey tomar company r kon part ke own kore. Investor thakle mane eta na je ora tomar revenue theke bhag nebe. Borong, tumi jodi website bikri koro tokhon ora bhag nebe.
    Tomar valuation barle investors taka kamay.
help_vc_offers_description: Tomar website er valuation barle tumi investment offers pete shuru korbe. Tomake ownership er kichu percentage chhere dite hobe, kintu oi taka diye tumi company aro taratari boro korte parbe.
help_vc_buyback_description: Ownership bar e pochonder share e click kore tumi tomar website er shares buy back korte paro. Price thik hoy website er current valuation diye.
help_events_intro: Tomar website e duto type er events hote pare: DDoS Attacks & Viral Boosts
help_events_ddos_description:
DDoS Attack holo emon ekta attack ja tomar servers overload kore website ke unavailable kore dite chay.

Ei attacks avoid kora jay na, kintu tumi nishchit korte paro je tomar servers attack samlanor moto jothesto powerful.
help_events_viral_description:
Viral boost mane tomar website kichu shomoyer jonno khub popular. Ei shomoye, jotokkhon tomar servers load nite pare, tumi prochur notun users pete paro.

Viral Boosts shudhu high satisfaction rating wala websites ei hoy.
help_support_intro:
Tomar website e joto beshi users ashbe, support tickets ashte shuru korbe.

Tickets ignore korle tomar website er support satisfaction kombe ar seta directly website er overall satisfaction rating ke affect korbe.
help_support_resolving_description: Tickets resolve korte shuru korte tomake ekta Supporter hire korte hobe. Notun hires automatically tomar prothom website er prothom available team e assign hoye jabe.
help_support_complexity_description:
Tickets 3 rokom complexity r hoy: Low, Medium ar High.

Shob Supporters shob type er tickets handle korte pare, kintu ticket joto complex, resolve korte toto beshi time lagbe. Tickets 36 ghontar moddhe resolve kora uchit, na hole segulo support satisfaction komate shuru korbe.

Tip: Supporters nijer level er sathe match kore emon tickets e kaj korte bhalobashe, na hole ora unhappy hote shuru kore.
help_support_teams_description:
Tomar website er Support tab use kore tumi tomar supporters der jonno teams setup korte paro. Medium ar High complexity tickets ashte shuru korle eta ekta important feature.

Teams setup kore tumi nishchit korte paro je Supporters shudhu tader level ar speed er sathe match kore emon tickets handle korbe.
help_ccc_intro: CCC (Centralized Clock Rate Controller) unit diye tumi ek jayga theke onek servers ar racks er clock rate control korte paro.
help_ccc_assign_description: Ekta rack ar tar shob servers ke CCC te assign korte, shudhu rack e click koro ar dropdown list theke pochonder CCC choose koro.
help_ccc_assign_multiple_headline: CCC te multiple racks assign kora
help_ccc_assign_multiple_description: Racks Menu use kore tumi onek gulo racks ekoi CCC te assign korte paro.
help_ccc_clockrate_description: Kono rules active na thakle clock rate koto thakbe, seta default clock rate control kore.
help_ccc_rules_description: CCC te tumi emon rules configure korte paro ja specific events e change hoy. Jemon, tumi default clock rate 0% set korte paro ar DDoS Attack hole CCC clock rate 100% e tule dibe.
help_production_intro_1: Ei employee types gulo components ar modules produce korte pare: Developers, Designers, LeadDevelopers, Marketers ar SysAdmins.
help_production_intro_2: Components ar modules diye website features, servers ba marketing campaigns er moto nana rokom items banano jay.
help_production_intro_3: Module holo shudhu kichu components ekshathe merge kore ekta banano.
help_production_intro_4: Ekta production employee ekbare shudhu ekta component ba module produce korte pare. Production time employee er total speed er upor based. Jodi kono employee ke ekta module banate plan kora hoy kintu tar requirements inventory te na thake, production theme jabe.
help_production_unlocking_headline: Aro components ar modules unlock kora
help_production_unlocking_description: Production menu te shudhu already research kora Components ar modules dekhabe. Aro unlock korte tomake Research Menu e jete hobe
help_production_queue_description: Production queue diye tumi age theke plan korte paro. Queue te add kora components/modules employee automatically banabe. List er shesh e pouchale employee automatically abar shuru theke korbe.
help_production_tip: Production automate korte ar onek employees manage kora shohoj korte tumi Managers use korte paro.
help_ceo_intro_description: Startup Company te CEO i ekmatro employee type jar skill change kora jay.
help_ceo_change_description: Tumi je kono shomoy tomar CEO er skill change korte paro. Dhyan dao, CEO er current skill change korle selected employees (manager) unassign hoye jabe, active tasks cancel hobe ar shob progress hariye jabe.
help_investment_intro:
Tomar company boro hote thakle ekshomoy emon jaygay pouchabe jekhane taka kono problem na.

Tokhon sadharonoto nijer company chhara onno projects e invest shuru korar bhalo shomoy. Shob investment projects ekta bonus unlock kore ja tomar company ke aro strong kore.
help_investment_investing_description: Shob projects e ekta upfront payment ar ekta daily contribution duto i lage. Dewa limits er moddhe tumi thik korbe protidin koto contribute korte chao.
help_investment_cancel_description:
Jodi tumi ar minimum daily contribution pay korte na paro, ba project e ar interest na thake, tumi project ta cancel korte paro. Tumi shob progress ar invest kora
taka harabe. Jekhane chhere chile sekhan theke ar continue korte parbe na. Project ta puro abar shuru theke korte hobe, upfront payment shoho.
tooltip_dismiss_cooldown: Ei employee ke fire korar age tomake {days} din wait korte hobe.
sell_delete_website_warning: Eta korte hole tomake tomar investors der buy out korte hobe.
hrmanager_granted_raise_label: {employeename} ({employeetype}) er salary ekta HR Manager {salaryraise}/month barieche ({bonus} bonus shoho).
allow_salary_raise_description: Eta korle HR Manager automatically shob affected employees der respond korbe jara competitor offers ba low mood er jonno salary raise chay.
retire_now_warning: Ei action e game shesh hoye jabe ar undo kora jabe na. Tumi ki sure je ekhoni retire korte chao?
upgrade_level_confirm: Tumi ki sure je selected employees der next level e upgrade korte chao? Salaries {price}/month bere jabe.
profilepage_description: Tomar users der nijer personal profile page banate ar onno users der profile dekhte dao.
manager_exceed_targets: Shob targets puron howar pore o producing continue koro (shoman bhabe distribute kore).
manager_skip_modules: Required components available na thakle modules skip koro.
manager_production_tip: Production plans shob managers er moddhe shared.
firstsupportticket_warning: {productname} tar prothom support ticket peyeche. Response time beshi hoye jawar age ekta Supporter hire kore nao!
steam_visround_release: Prai 5 bochor development er pore Startup Company ekhon Full Release e out!
steam_store_page_intro: Startup Company ekta business simulation sandbox game. Tumi ekta chhotto startup er CEO ar tomar company boro korar jonno ekdom ready. Ektu investment niye tumi ekta darun website banate namcho, duniyar sobcheye boro tech giants der sathe compete korte, history r sobcheye valuable company hobar asha niye.
steam_store_page_website_description: Tomar company r success depend kore tumi website ta kemon chalate ar manage korte paro tar upor. Tomake features develop ar improve korte hobe, shathe hosting capacity barate hobe ar marketing campaigns chalate hobe.
steam_store_page_office_description: City tomake shob size ar shape er offices offer kore. Sobcheye suitable ta beche nite hobe tomakei. Office organize ar decorate kora tomar kaj, shathe employees der happy rakhao.
steam_store_page_employees_description: Tomar success er ekta boro part tomar employees. Company boro hote thakle tomake aro lok recruit korte hobe. Shomoyer sathe tomar employees tomar ar company r kach theke aro beshi demand korte shuru korbe. Competitors oder emon job offer pathanor age jeta ora reject korte parbe na, oder happy rakha tomar kaj!
steam_store_page_servers_description: Stable ar reliable servers chhara kono website hoy na. Tomar website e traffic barle tomake virtual servers theke nijer fully featured hosting center e shift korte hobe.
steam_store_page_competition_description: Goal ta clear: industry r sobcheye boro website hoye otha. Tumi competitors der kine merge korbe naki oder piche fele egiye jabe jotokkhon na ora business theke out hoy - seta tomar upor!
steam_store_page_community_description:
Amra mone kori ekta strong community gaming experience ke shudhu bhalo i kore. Tai Startup Company Steam Workshop diye puro moddable.

Amra amader community ke Localizor diye game ta translate korte help korar invite korchi: [url]https://www.localizor.com/game/1/translations[/url]
help_camera_controls_panning_headline_in: Game camera te duto option ache: panning ar zooming. Camera rotate kora jay na.
